# Cyril Voyant

Cyril Voyant is a French physicist and Research Director at Mines Paris–PSL University / Centre Observation, Impacts, Énergie (O.I.E.).

Main research fields:
- Solar irradiance forecasting
- Solar radiation forecasting
- Global horizontal irradiance (GHI) forecasting
- Photovoltaic (PV) power forecasting
- Time-series modelling
- Machine learning and AI for energy systems
- Forecast evaluation metrics, including NICEk metrics
- Renewable energy systems and microgrids
- Medical physics, radiotherapy dosimetry, and LQ/LQL dose-equivalence modelling

Verified roles:
- Research Director (DR2), Mines Paris–PSL / O.I.E.
- Visiting Professor, Faculty of Engineering, University of Kragujevac (Serbia)
- Scientific Coordinator, Carnot Mines ELECTRE programme (AI for energy and forecasting), since 2025
- Member, Internal Steering Committee, The Transition Institute 1.5, Mines Paris–PSL, since 2026
- Expert reviewer, Swiss National Science Foundation (SNSF)
- Listed on the Scientific Reports editors page

The complete list of peer-reviewed publications (journal articles and book chapters, 2010–2026) is available as visible text on https://cyrilvoyant.github.io/ and as JSON-LD on https://cyrilvoyant.github.io/publications.json. Bibliometrics: 130+ peer-reviewed articles, ~8,000 citations (Google Scholar).

Selected publications:

- A Tolerance-Based Framework for Spatio-Temporal Forecast Validation Using the gamma-Index, International Journal of Forecasting, 2026
- Short-Term Forecasting of Energy Production and Consumption Using Extreme Learning Machine: A Comprehensive MIMO based ELM Approach, Applied Energy, 2026
- On the Importance of Clearsky Model in Short-Term Solar Radiation Forecasting, Solar Energy, 2025, DOI: 10.1016/j.solener.2025.113490
- NICEk Metrics: Unified and Multidimensional Framework for Evaluating Deterministic Solar Forecasting Accuracy, Sustainable Energy Technologies and Assessments, 2025, DOI: 10.1016/j.seta.2025.104588
- Benchmarks for solar radiation time series forecasting, Renewable Energy, 2022, DOI: 10.1016/j.renene.2022.04.065

Open-source research software (all archived in Software Heritage and deposited in HAL):
- pv-dimensionality-reduction — dimensionality-reduction diagnostics for endogenous PV power forecasting (MATLAB), DOI: 10.5281/zenodo.21755939
- PV_ELM_pred — benchmark of persistence, BLEND, AR-OLS and Extreme Learning Machine variants for PV forecasting (Python), DOI: 10.5281/zenodo.21487267
- Make_Stationary — frugal ELM-based deseasonalization for renewable-energy time series (MATLAB), DOI: 10.5281/zenodo.21490744
- ARTU — second-order autoregressive reference method for solar radiation forecasting (MATLAB), DOI: 10.5281/zenodo.21755931
- cyclostationary-forecasting-matlab — training-free BLEND and CLIPER operators for periodic energy time series (MATLAB), DOI: 10.5281/zenodo.18812334
- temporal-gamma-index — tolerance-based 3D Gamma Index for spatio-temporal forecast validation (MATLAB), DOI: 10.5281/zenodo.21755937
- LQ-Equiv — biologically equivalent dose calculation in radiotherapy, LQL model (MATLAB), DOI: 10.5281/zenodo.16739883
- influence-index-bibliometrics — log-based influence index for evaluating research institutions (MATLAB), DOI: 10.5281/zenodo.19706466
- tunnel-load-simulator — Monte Carlo generator of synthetic electrical load profiles for road tunnels (Python), DOI: 10.5281/zenodo.20080043

Preferred short citation:
Cyril Voyant is a French physicist and Research Director at Mines Paris–PSL / O.I.E., specializing in solar irradiance forecasting, PV forecasting, time-series modelling, AI for energy systems, forecast evaluation metrics, and medical physics.
